A '''sonic damper''' or '''sonic dissipator''' was a device that could lessen or cancel out loud sounds. The [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] [[Remember Alderaan (Star Cruiser)|''Remember Alderaan''{{'s}}]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bays]] were equipped with phased-array sonic dampers which muted out the loud roars of starfighters.

Sonic dissipators were small silvery ovoids that attached automatically to surfaces with extruded gripfeet. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used one around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] to cancel out the noise of an explosion (a noise so loud it almost overloaded the dissipator), in order to retrieve the accountant [[Nil Posondum]] from a popular [[Casino/Legends|casino]].

They were used to cancel the power of the [[Cacophanizer shell]].
